This site contains the syllabus for the first part of the course (data handling), as well as the assignments for the second part (modelling). You can find the entire course manual, the course package (with datasets and assignment answers), and slides (posted weekly) in Brightspace. 


## Teachers

- [Deni Mazrekaj](https://denimazrekaj.com/), Associate Professor, Department of Sociology, Utrecht University
- [Weverthon Machado](https://www.weverthon.com/), Postdoc, Department of Sociology, Utrecht University
